svg.aria-label: Schematic of JANUS: a real Gaia XP spectrum of a red giant and the seismic input from TESS and Kepler go into an ensemble of eight normalising-flow networks, 110 inputs to six outputs, which returns six labels with a spread and a miss probability; the test on withheld stars gives the scatter about APOGEE, and the catalogue covers 144,304 TESS giants.

g.text: filled: the one in ten that also have APOGEE DR19 values
